INSIDE A MAKER REPORT

What we checked, and what we could not find.

The report separates public evidence from unconfirmed claims. Certificate status, source links, possible red flags and the date checked sit alongside a provisional FI Score.

A careful label.
“Not found” does not mean “failed”. A certificate becomes Verified only after a person checks the issuer’s register. Every report needs human approval before publication.
